target.title: fix(browser): respect --timeout-ms for browser evaluate command
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Issue #103137 reports that `openclaw browser evaluate --fn "() => 1 + 1" --timeout-ms 60000` aborts after approximately 15 seconds, ignoring the `--timeout-ms` parameter. This prevents users from running long-running JavaScript evaluations in the browser context, such as waiting for async operations or complex computations.

The root cause was that `preauthHandshakeTimeoutMs` in `callGatewayWithScopes` only used `context.config.gateway?.handshakeTimeoutMs` without falling back to the request `timeoutMs`. When gateway handshake timeout was not configured, the timeout handling was inconsistent, causing evaluate commands to abort prematurely.

## Why This Change Was Made

The fix ensures that when `gateway.handshakeTimeoutMs` is not explicitly configured, the gateway uses the request `timeoutMs` parameter (which comes from the CLI `--timeout-ms` option). This allows users to control the timeout for long-running evaluate functions.

## User Impact

Users can now successfully run browser evaluate commands with custom timeouts:
- `openclaw browser evaluate --fn "async () => { await delay(30000); return \"done\"; }" --timeout-ms 60000`
- Long-running async evaluations will complete instead of aborting at ~15s

## Evidence

### Code Analysis
- CLI layer correctly passes `--timeout-ms` through `callBrowserAct` → `callBrowserRequest` → gateway RPC (verified by existing test: `extensions/browser/src/cli/browser-cli-actions-input/register.form-wait-eval.test.ts:177-193`)
- Gateway RPC layer calculates `resolvedTimeoutMs` with 5000ms slack for routing overhead
- The bug was in `src/gateway/call.ts:1232` where `preauthHandshakeTimeoutMs` did not fall back to `timeoutMs`

### Test Results
```
$ pnpm test extensions/browser/src/cli/browser-cli-actions-input/register.form-wait-eval.test.ts
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  9 passed (9)
   Duration  34.17s

$ pnpm test extensions/browser/src/browser/pw-tools-core.interactions.batch.test.ts
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  2 passed (2)
   Duration  5.17s
```

### Files Changed
- `src/gateway/call.ts:1232-1235` - Add fallback to `timeoutMs` when `gateway.handshakeTimeoutMs` is undefined

Fixes: #103137
